title: Netflix holds quarterly earnings call following leadership shakeup and layoffs
description:
Mandalit del Barco

Netflix reported its latest quarterly earnings on Tuesday. It comes as the streaming company has announced a management shakeup and layoffs of more than 1,000 employees.
